title: quantms YAML Manifest Schema
description: Schema for quantms YAML input manifests (current specification). Defines experiment metadata, samples, multiplex mixtures, runs, and named modification profiles. Includes controlled vocabularies and ontology annotations for machine validation.

experiment.title: Experiment Configuration
experiment.description: Top-level experiment settings including MS acquisition method, enzyme, quantification method, and structured experiment-level modifications.

acquisition_method.description: Mass spectrometry acquisition method: Data-dependent (DDA) or data-independent (DIA).

quantification_method.description: Quantification method: Label-free (LFQ), isobaric (TMT, iTRAQ), or metabolic labeling (SILAC). Used to declare the quantification strategy upfront.

enzyme.description: Protease used for digestion (e.g., Trypsin, Chymotrypsin, Pepsin). Must be a recognized protease name.

dissociation_method.description: Fragmentation/dissociation method used (e.g., HCD, CID, ETD). Machine validation enforces known MS dissociation methods.

modifications.description: Structured experiment-level modifications. Each modification specifies its mode (fixed or variable) and applies to all samples in the experiment. Ontology-backed modifications require either accession or name; custom modifications require name and mass_shift.

id.description: Unique identifier for this modification entry.

kind.description: Modification type: 'ontology' for UniMod/MOD-backed, 'custom' for user-defined.

name.description: Human-readable modification name. Required for custom modifications; optional for ontology if accession provided.

accession.description: Ontology accession (UNIMOD:<number> or MOD:<number>). Required for ontology if name not provided.

mode.description: Modification mode: 'fixed' for static modifications, 'variable' for optional dynamic modifications. Required.

mass_shift.description: Monoisotopic mass shift in Daltons. Required for custom modifications.

custom_mod_profile.description: Reference to a modification profile ID (from mod_profiles section) to use as experiment-level modifications. If specified, takes precedence over the 'modifications' array.

precursor_mass_tolerance.description: Precursor mass tolerance with unit (e.g., '10 ppm', '5 Da').

fragment_mass_tolerance.description: Fragment mass tolerance with unit (e.g., '0.02 Da', '20 ppm').

samples.title: Biological Samples
samples.description: List of unique biological samples in the experiment. Each sample is a distinct biological unit. Includes sample metadata with CV expectations.

id.description: Unique sample identifier. Used to reference samples in mixtures and runs.

organism.description: Organism or species (e.g., 'homo sapiens', 'mus musculus'). Should use NCBI Taxonomy names in lowercase.

organism_part.description: Tissue or organ source (e.g., 'liver', 'brain', 'cell line'). Should use UBERON for tissues.

condition.description: Experimental condition or treatment (e.g., 'control', 'treatment_A'). Free text but should map to experimental design.

technical_replicate.description: Technical replicate number for multiple measurements of the same biological sample (e.g., 1, 2, 3).

disease.description: Disease or disease state if applicable. Should use DOID (Disease Ontology) terms.

cell_type.description: Cell type if applicable (e.g., 'HeLa', 'neuron', 'fibroblast'). Should use CL (Cell Ontology) terms.

additional_metadata.description: Free-form additional metadata fields (e.g., cell_line, passage, donor_age, treatment_group).

mixtures.title: Multiplex Mixtures
mixtures.description: Groups of samples multiplexed together via isobaric labels (TMT, iTRAQ) or relative quantification labels (SILAC). The channel namespace is flexible and determined by the experiment_type and channels used. Empty array allowed for label-free quantification (LFQ) experiments.

id.description: Unique mixture identifier. Used to link runs to mixtures.

channels.description: Mapping of channel names/labels to sample IDs. For TMT: use TMT126, TMT127N, etc. For SILAC: use light/heavy or R0K0/R6K4/R10K8. Keys are label identifiers; values are sample IDs. Machine validation enforces valid channel sets per plex type.

x-channel-types.TMT: TMT2, TMT6, TMT10, TMT11, TMT16, TMT18

runs.title: Raw Data Runs
runs.description: List of raw spectrometry files (runs) with their metadata and mixture/fraction assignments.

file.description: Path or URI to the raw spectrometry file (e.g., 's3://bucket/data.raw', '/local/path/file.mzML').

mixture.description: Mixture ID this run belongs to. Must match a mixture defined in the mixtures section. Null for label-free quantification (LFQ) runs.

instrument.description: Instrument type or model used (e.g., 'Q_TOF', 'Orbitrap_Fusion'). Should use PSI-MS instrument CV.

custom_mod_profile.description: Reference to a modification profile ID (from mod_profiles section) to override experiment-level modifications for this run.

mod_profiles.title: Modification Profiles
mod_profiles.description: Named modification definitions. Each entry describes ONE modification (ontology-backed or custom-defined) with optional engine-specific parameters. Supports two types: ontology-backed modifications (kind=ontology, requires either accession or name) and custom modifications (kind=custom, requires name and mass_shift). Reference a profile by its 'id' via 'custom_mod_profile' at experiment or run level.

id.description: Unique identifier referenced by 'custom_mod_profile' at experiment or run level.

kind.description: Modification type: 'ontology' for UniMod/MOD-backed modifications, 'custom' for user-defined modifications without ontology reference. Defaults to 'ontology'.

name.description: Human-readable modification name (e.g., 'Phosphorylation', 'TMT 16-plex'). Required if accession is not provided for ontology modifications; required for custom modifications.

accession.description: Ontology accession for ontology-backed modifications. Must be UNIMOD:<number> or MOD:<number> format. Required if name is not provided for ontology modifications.

residues.description: Target residue(s) or terminus (e.g., 'M', ['S','T','Y'], 'N-term', 'C-term'). Required for all modifications to specify which amino acid or terminus is modified.

mode.description: Modification mode: 'fixed' for static modifications applied to all peptides, 'variable' for optional dynamic modifications. Required.

mass_shift.description: Monoisotopic mass shift in Daltons (e.g., 79.966331 for phosphorylation). Required for custom modifications.

term_spec.description: Terminal specificity for this modification: 'none' (no terminal restriction), 'n-term', 'c-term', 'protein-n-term', 'protein-c-term'. Required.

comet.description: Comet-specific modification parameters at root level.

min_occurrences.description: Minimum number of times this modification must occur on a peptide.

max_occurrences.description: Maximum number of times this modification may occur on a peptide.

distance_from_terminus.description: Maximum distance from terminus for terminus-proximal modifications (-1 = unrestricted).

sage.description: Sage-specific modification parameters at root level.

diann.description: DIA-NN-specific modification parameters at root level.

msgf.description: MS-GF+-specific modification parameters at root level.

then.description: Ontology-backed modification must have at least one of 'accession' or 'name'.
